title: SEGMENT-VECTOR-SQRTLOGCAP: intermediate growing allowance gives explicit subpolynomial time penalty

claims.statement: For EVERY integer N>=2 and secret s moduloN, n=ceil(log2N), the SINGLE finite SEGMENT-VECTOR-SQRTLOGCAP algorithm of proof.md/nonpower_merge.md/qudit_decoder.md recovers the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. ALLFOUR resource bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY execution branch in the stated charged Clifford+T/bit/source/address model, including all failures/retries/real projections, rejected/discarded/partial acquisitions, incorrect labels/prefixes, initialization/table/circuit generation, gates/measurements/reset and finite-prefix costs. Mainn>=2^128 uses actualCleaf=ceil(sqrt(u))+64,u=ceil(log2n), atmost128 support-reset cycles, finite physicalCRT/Dirichlet coarse jumps and full fine-vector PGM with the exact source/controller caps of the proof. Actualplateau/initialization growing factors are included. The finite prefix has a separate all-secret success proof and uniform absolute resource constants. Exactq=141421/100000,t=39999899241/28284200000. Total charged work isO(n^(5/2)2^(t sqrt n+sqrt(log2n))),exactgrowthindex1/2.
